_about: Settings for make_videos.py. Folder names are relative to the folder this file is in. Lines that start with an underscore are notes and are ignored.

folders._note: voice = where your Piper model lives. voiceovers = where the made voiceovers are saved. fonts = optional extra .ttf files (Windows fonts are found automatically).

batch._note: The bold labels in Batch.md that mark the hook and the prayer text. Everything else in a day is ignored.

piper._note: command: auto finds Piper by itself. If it cannot, put the full path of piper.exe here. model: a file name inside the voice folder, or a full path. voice_speed: 1.0 normal, 0.9 slower, 1.1 faster. pause_between_hook_and_prayer: seconds of silence. sentence_pause: seconds of silence between sentences, or null for the voice's own default. speaker: a number for multi-speaker models, otherwise null.

timing._note: The voiceover starts this many seconds in, and the video continues this many seconds after the voiceover ends.

text._note: The text starts coming in in_before_voice seconds before the voice starts, and starts going out out_after_voice seconds after the voice ends. Each video gets ONE effect from the list (used for both in and out). With no_repeat_effects_in_batch the effects are not repeated until every effect has been used, so keep at least as many effects as you have days in a batch. no_repeat_looks_in_batch does the same for the look.json sets.

video._note: ratio: auto (9:16, or 16:9 if most clips are landscape), 9:16 or 16:9. crf: quality, lower is better. preset: faster presets render quicker (veryfast, fast, medium, slow). trim_pattern repeats; trims at least long_trim_seconds long get the slow zoom and the transitions. transitions_at: both, into or out (of the long trims). allow_clip_repeat: false means every trim in a video comes from a different clip (needs about 8-14 clips).

music._note: volume_vs_voice: 0.5 means the music is half as loud as the voiceover (it still drops further while the voice speaks).
